name: 19-provider-rule-offline-and-jobs
description: A workspace made before the rules arrived gets the seven shipped rules from the one-time write. The builder hands off from its Claude login to a Gemini login, so both providers have built the task: at submit no reviewer may take the review, because the Claude and Gemini reviewers are refused by the provider rule and the Codex reviewer's accounts are all limited, and No reviewer is eligible opens. The Claude and Gemini reviewers' claims skip the review and are refused not_eligible, each recording an applied check, and the waiting step takes the rule as its cause. When the Codex login resets, the reviewer_eligibility timer resolves the item; later that reviewer's limit passes over the Claude login below it and releases the review, and the owner turns the provider rule off so the Claude reviewer passes it. Meanwhile a details check misses its run timeout twice with the orchestrator online, holds its task with check_error and its item, and the owner's Run it again passes it; and on a third task the orchestrator's limit hands its job's run to its next login, which also meets a limit with no candidate below, so the orchestrator goes offline, the check errs with only the workspace item open, and when the first login resets the orchestrator is back and the errored check is queued again and passes.
covers: PRD Shipped rules, L434, with Q-12, and milestone 4 plan RD-2, RD-3: install_shipped_rules writes rule.created for each shipped rule, with the app as actor and no key, on a workspace that has none.

PRD Shipped rules, the provider rule, test 8 L912, and milestone 4 plan RD-50, RD-12, RD-11: a reviewer on a provider that built the task, one reached by handoff included, is skipped by review claim-next and refused not_eligible; its applied row with effect refused is written once per reviewer and round, and the waiting step names the rule from the first.

Plan SM-42 and milestone 4 plan RD-51: No reviewer is eligible opens at submit when no reviewer may take the review, a reviewer whose accounts are all limited counting as none, and the reviewer_eligibility timer resolves it when that account resets.
PRD Handoff, L913, and milestone 4 plan RD-50: a reviewer's limit passes over every candidate of a provider that built the task, and with none left the review is released.

PRD When a check cannot run, L399-L400, and plan SM-39: a run timeout's first miss queues a new attempt on a new job; the second miss gives error, a check_error hold and, with the orchestrator online, its task item; Run it again queues one more attempt, and its result closes the hold and completes the pending move (milestone 4 plan RD-42, RD-43).

PRD When a check cannot run, L401-L402, and milestone 4 plan RD-16, RD-19, RD-40: a limit report for a job hands its run to the next login, and with no candidate the orchestrator stops claiming jobs and counts as offline; the workspace item opens once a check waits and no task item opens; when the orchestrator is back the item resolves and the errored check is queued again.
